name: Yulia F. Malberione
original_name: 優梨亜・Ｆ・マルベリオーネ
source:
Grade: First Year
Affiliation: Health Committee 
attributes: Really Horny Nun, childhood friend
Problems: Her erogenous zone is seen as sinful by her religion.
Erogenous Zone(s): Anus
Yulia a Sister of the St. Malberione church located within the Academy, and serves in its Health committee.
She can't help but help the people who are in trouble, feeling deep mercy for others, and she is very serious. But contrary to school rules, Yulia sometimes plays pranks on the juniors. 
With her status as a Sister, she feels resistant to do anything with Shunosuke, she is really curious about sex (and thus she masturbates often).
As a Sister in the church, she sees Shaula as her rival (in love, in religion, AND in horniness).
